decision: RS defaults to OFF under the current replacement treatment. This prevents known quality loss while the invariant R0-plus-RS-delta treatment is implemented and qualified under the same frozen generator.

evidence.denominator_note: EvoEmo pure RS-only (MS off) pairs plus ESConv pairs under the current Llama treatment; position-randomized blind quality review.
evidence.bounded_interpretation: The observed current-treatment result strongly disfavors deploying RS ON by default. Winning-case rationales suggest that some routed wins arose when baseline made an error that the narrow routed response avoided. This is a diagnosis and hypothesis, not proof that benefit is intrinsically unpredictable or independent of sample size; observable state features could still predict such baseline-error risk in future data.

relationship_to_primary_success_rule.effect_on_same_stack_outcome: NOT PASS. Comparing OFF with OFF is a deployment identity check, not evidence that a learned RS component has useful conditional behavior against RS-off and same-stack baselines.
relationship_to_primary_success_rule.effect_on_selector_nondegeneracy: NOT PASS. An effectively always-off component equals the simple baseline and cannot demonstrate a learned selection improvement.
relationship_to_primary_success_rule.paper1_primary_consequence: Because the primary predicate requires RS_pass, default-off keeps the primary claim open/failed until a redesigned RS treatment passes prospectively. It cannot be used to satisfy the predicate by definition.
relationship_to_primary_success_rule.not_a_reinterpretation_of: The historical rs_open_close_construct_v2.json is not bound to the current authority; this policy is only a fail-closed operational decision grounded in the current paired-outcome data.

reversal_conditions: The versioned invariant R0-plus-RS-delta response-program redesign is frozen before outcomes and shows useful grouped same-stack behavior against the identical R0 foundation.
Only after the repaired treatment passes its current-generator development gate, a generator-factor experiment may test robustness or capacity interaction.
Enough independent groups with genuine material benefit accumulate to train and prospectively confirm a nondegenerate eligibility rule.
